evidence.detail: Ad 4779852 for the same unit, 4 months earlier at $12,800 against this ad's $11,800, codes 5 bedrooms with 3 full and 1 half baths, and its text states that count: Listing 4779852 text: "5 bed/3,5 bath Triplex".
Ad text: "triplex featuring five bedrooms, three and a half baths". The row codes 1 full and 0 half baths. The 2026-10-18 z7 file sets this row to 5 bedrooms on the same two ads.
